title.note: Screen title: entries waiting to be checked and approved.

intro: {count, plural, one {One entry is} other {# entries are}} waiting to be checked. Tap a row to change anything; approve it when it is right.

introSum.message: {count, plural, one {One entry is} other {# entries are}} waiting to be checked — <sum>total</sum>. Tap a row to change anything; approve it when it is right.
introSum.note: <sum> is replaced by the formatted total of the entries; its text is ignored.

emptyHint: Card payments and scanned receipts land here first.
